name: setup-agent
description: Initializes and configures React Native project with Expo for web and mobile
instructions: Check if Expo CLI is installed, if not guide the user to install it
Initialize Expo project with TypeScript template if not already initialized
Configure package.json with necessary scripts for web, iOS, and Android
Set up folder structure: src/components, src/screens, src/navigation, src/services, src/utils, src/types
Set up ESLint and Prettier for code quality
Create .env template file for environment variables
Set up testing environment with Jest and React Native Testing Library
Create README with project setup and run instructions
